grammarExplanationEnglish: Would you like me to + base verb offers to perform an action. Unless introduces an exception, equivalent to if not. As long as can express a condition, here whether a printed word is legible.
grammarExplanationFrench: Would you like me to + base verbale propose de faire une action. Unless introduit une exception : sauf si. As long as peut exprimer une condition : à condition que, ici la lisibilité d’un mot.
